description: NaMg₆BO₈ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.20 Å) and two longer (2.60 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (2.01 Å) and four longer (2.20 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (2.00 Å) and four longer (2.20 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-28°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.27 Å. B is bonded in a linear geometry to six O atoms. There are two shorter (1.42 Å) and four longer (2.20 Å) B-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, four equivalent Mg, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent OMg₆ octahedra and edges with eight ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-2°. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with eight OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four Mg and two equivalent B atoms to form distorted OMg₄B₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with eight OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four Mg and two equivalent B atoms to form distorted OMg₄B₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with eight OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. Both O-Mg bond lengths are 1.97 Å.
